finance.title: The World Cup sends prediction market volumes soaring to record highs

finance.title: Married Americans tend to be wealthier and happier. Gen Z is forgoing the institution anyway
finance.summary: Gen Z defines the American Dream as having financial stability and being happy. Marriage could help them reach both of those goals, but many aren't sold on it.

ai.title: 43% Indian firms use AI, but workforce readiness still lags
ai.description: Aon's Human Capital Trends Study found 43% of Indian organisations have deployed artificial intelligence, with another 20% piloting it. The findings show adoption is rising faster than workforce readiness and benefits alignment.
ai.title_cn: 43%的印度公司使用人工智能，但劳动力准备状况仍然滞后
ai.description_cn: 怡安的人力资本趋势研究发现，43%的印度组织已经部署了人工智能，另有20%正在进行试点。研究结果显示，采用率的增长速度快于劳动力准备和福利调整。

ai.title: Indian IT firms likely to report muted Q1 growth amid AI spending, macro uncertainty
ai.description: India's Information Technology (IT) companies are expected to report another quarter of subdued earnings growth despite seasonal strength, due to client-specific issues, weakness in select verticals and geopolitical uncertainty. Addressable tech spending in Indian IT companies is expected to remain softer year-on-year as enterprises redirect technology budgets towards artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives and Global Capability Centres (GCCs), according to a report by Systematix Research.
ai.title_cn: 由于人工智能支出和宏观不确定性，印度IT公司可能报告第一季度增长疲软
ai.description_cn: 尽管由于客户特定问题、特定垂直行业疲软和地缘政治不确定性，印度信息技术（IT）公司预计将报告另一个季度的盈利增长疲软，但季节性强劲。根据Systematix Research的一份报告，随着企业将技术预算转向人工智能（AI）计划和全球能力中心（BCC），印度IT公司的可解决技术支出预计将同比保持疲软。
